description: Create a recurring calendar event. It generates event instances on a schedule, each with the reminders set in reminderOffsetMinutes.

cronExpression.description: Interval as 'N Unit', Unit one of Day, Week, Month, Year, e.g. '2 Week'. Not cron syntax.

duration.description: Length of each instance, ISO 8601 duration e.g. 'PT30M'.

endDate.description: Last date an instance may fall on, YYYY-MM-DD.

isAllDay.description: True for all-day instances, false for timed. An all-day instance starts at midnight of its occurrence date in the template timezone (stored in UTC; omit startTime) and ends duration later (no end without a duration), so a duration of one day or more makes each instance span that many whole days.

location.description: Where each instance happens. $type 'Address' takes line1-3/postalCode/countryCode; 'OnlineLocation' takes url/notes.

line1.description: Address line 1. An Address needs one of line1-3 or postalCode.

line2.description: Address line 2, e.g. flat or suite.

notes.description: Access detail, e.g. parking or passcode.

reminderOffsetMinutes.description: Reminder lead times, in minutes before each occurrence starts. Each value is whole hours, 60-1380 (1-23 hours), or whole days, a multiple of 1440 up to 40320 (4 weeks, the most for a repeating item); a week is 10080. Up to 5 values. An all-day event counts from 00:00 on its first day, so 300 (5 hours) is 19:00 the evening before. Day and week reminders arrive at 19:00 on the earlier day; hour reminders arrive that many hours before the start, or up to 15 minutes earlier. Every household member is reminded.

items.description: One lead time in minutes: whole hours 60-1380, or a multiple of 1440 for days.

startDate.description: Date of the first instance, YYYY-MM-DD. Later ones repeat from it.

startTime.description: Local start time, HH:mm:ss. Omit if there is no fixed time.

timezone.description: IANA zone for startTime, e.g. 'Europe/London'. Occurrences follow its DST.

name: create_recurring_calendar_event
